hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

Attached to the Implementation Profile https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/band-retrieval (implementsProfile), after checking its signature (docs/ATTACHMENTS.md).

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/activity-type/band-retrieval, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature, http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Feature.

processDescription.inherited.json added with the attachment to the Implementation Profile band-retrieval: the deployed processDescription with each bound input and output linked to the role it implements (metadata, role implementation-input or implementation-output) and carrying that role's dataType; the profile schema inherits it. The deployed processDescription is unchanged.
roleDecompositions added: the role areaOfInterest of band-retrieval is taken as the four inputs west, south, east and north, none of which carries its representation.

plan: executionUnit.href moves from the v0.0.2-rc2 release of GeoLabs/KindGrove to the v0.0.2-rc3 release (mangrove-workflow-steps.cwl#download_band). The rc3 CWL declares the format of its Files (the ipython2cwl format annotation), so the processDescription derived from it changes: contentMediaType application/octet-stream -> image/tiff; application=geotiff (with contentEncoding binary) for the output band_file and application/octet-stream -> application/geo+json (with contentEncoding binary) for the input stac_item, in processDescription.json and processDescription.inherited.json. The assumedFormatGaps recorded at the attachment on 2026-11-10 for stac_item and band_file were removed the same day, when the corrected CWL served these formats; the entry has none.

prefLabel: Download one Sentinel-2 band over a bounding box
definition: Downloads one Sentinel-2 band over a bounding box from a STAC Item.

roleDecompositions.note: The area of interest is taken as the four bounds of a bounding box, in EPSG:4326 (hard-coded in the notebook, read), not as one OGC API - Processes bounding box: the representation bounding-box-ogcapi-processes-bbox of the role is not served.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: load_collection with a spatial_extent and a single band selected (filter_bands); the STAC item is a resolved File (the output of `select-scene`) rather than resolved in-process, same pattern as `algae-bloom.download-band-sentinel2-stac-item`.
